steps: Live source_statement: C_SIZE(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} for the beta-zero parity carrier is the lower-bound statement being audited, not assumed true.

Model_context: source carrier H_N^SAT uses generated polylog SAT formulas; target class is nonuniform SIZE; proof model is restricted Psys_sym^ext; reduction type is parser-to-circuit simulation plus equality patching, not a proof of P != NP.

Quantifier_context: N ranges over valid carrier lengths, epsilon>0 is fixed, q and rho are fixed below 1+epsilon, beta=0, parser uniformity is advice-free, and pi may be nonuniform only as the alleged proof/certificate object being audited.

Define Cl_t, the prefix row-influence closure before line t. Initialize it from bit-explicit EF dependencies, SATeq links, bounded-SR_h leaves, and declared extension supports already covered by Gamma_bEF.

For a transparent FormulaEval line, add either the enumerated RowSet_l with cost U_l and occurrence expansion X_l, or the full-scan support over all M_N rows with cost N^{1+q+o(1)}; propagate this set to every later line that reads the symbolic value.

For an admitted semantic line, require a RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N object before the line is usable; add its generated row indices, occurrence neighborhoods, and verifier overhead to R_N and to Cl_t.

Induct on proof lines: given Cl_t and the prefix circuit of size Gamma_prefix(t), bit-explicit EF and SR_h rules preserve locality by the cycle-102 normal form; transparent FormulaEval preserves locality by explicit RowSet expansion; inherited closures prevent later hidden support reuse.

At the final lower-bound line, assemble a circuit for H_N^SAT from the generator, the charged transcript circuit, and equality patches for E_pi exceptional source rows; its size is at most N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_comp(pi)+E_pi N.

Contrapositive: if pi is presented as a proof of LB_N(1+epsilon) while the displayed cost is subthreshold, the constructed circuit contradicts the LB_N statement in the same SIZE model; this is a route-level falsifier theorem, not evidence for P != NP.

Reviewer findings: reduction-consistency passes for Psys_sym^ext because source and target circuits are the same nonuniform model; quantifier-uniformity passes only with advice-free parser clauses; barrier-specificity says extensional hidden support is relativizing and refuted by private rows, while RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N is the named nonrelativizing open obligation.

scheduler_decisions.reason: The live risk is that a meta-complexity carrier supplies aggregate or advice-selected hardness rather than a uniform language lower bound.
result_atlas_open_obligations: Formalize the odd-charge Tseitin embedding with a dummy SAT projection and prove the proper-subsystem satisfiability lemma over F_2; then test one named proof system for an advice-free cluster satisfying DirectClusterSound(C,k) at d,b=O(log N).

Instantiate the odd-charge Tseitin parity-ambiguity test inside the named DCS-LC local projection system: list the tested projections, construct two projection-identical labelings with opposite row parity or prove that a checked global parity axiom prevents them.
No current proof supplies a uniform logarithmic-projection cluster with DirectClusterSound(C,k) for SAT lower bounds. The gap is local target soundness, not proof length or global PCP soundness.

The remaining open validation is proving row-parity SAT-semantic binding for the named DCS-LC proof system. Local consistency, ordinary soundness, or cluster agreement alone does not imply this binding; an odd-charge Tseitin-style parity ambiguity remains a concrete falsifier.
